decision: Freeze the selected router for independent folds-0/1 confirmation.

deployment_order: if physical_location_id appeared in model training, return the exact current score
otherwise compute site size and predicted-positive rate from current scores only
apply the fixed invariant pair only when both frozen site gates pass
return the exact current score for every other unseen site
routing.development_interpretation: each held fold's physical sites are unseen to the opposite-fold representation and all are eligible for the label-free gate
routing.predicted_positive_rate: fraction of a physical site's current scene scores >= scene_threshold
routing.scene_threshold_source: frozen current-score matched-FPR threshold on folds 3+4 before router search

scope: post-fold2-failure development-only label-free unseen-site routing on folds 3+4

definition.membership: all folds-3/4 rows from physical_location_id groups whose scene-positive rate is <=0.05
definition.name: low-prevalence physical-location proxy for the official test-only-site view
definition.use: evaluation and gating only; true site prevalence never enters routing
